Bulk Import DNC Numbers

Upload a CSV file with phone numbers to add to the DNC list. Expected column: phone (E.164 format).

Click to upload CSV

One phone number per row in E.164 format

The CSV should contain one phone number per line. An optional header row with "phone" is accepted and will be skipped. Use E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567).
